name: Analog Systems IIb
description: The course introduces analog signal processing and the characteristics of an ideal operational amplifier. Key topics include negative feedback, virtual ground, inverting and non-inverting amplifiers, integrators, differentiators, and instrumentation amplifiers. Students will also study passive and active filters, comparators, Schmitt triggers with hysteresis, and oscillator circuits, including LC and transconductor-based oscillators, with a focus on design and analysis of complete analog systems.
